column1: # Swab metadata. HAND-MAINTAINED - the pipeline reads this file and never writes it.
# site_id      stable key. Free text will not join across runs: "Changi T3 departure" and
#              "T3 dep." are different strings and would split one site into two.
# site_label   what a human reads on the report.
# collected_at ISO date the swab was TAKEN, which is not the date it was sequenced.
# run_id       sequencing run. Needed to tell a site effect from a batch effect.
# A blank cell means NOT CAPTURED and renders as such. Do not fill one in to make a column
# look complete - a guessed site silently joins two swabs that were never in the same place.
# site_label values below are transcribed from 101_Documentation.md and README.md.
# collected_at and run_id are blank because this project never recorded them; the five swabs
# are known to have been sequenced in SEPARATE batches, but the run identifiers are lost.
